title: Black Plague
description: The Project Adds the Black Death To Minecraft!
body: This will add the Black Plague to minecraft! Made by sabby911 as a single dev. I am very happy for you to download this! How it works: Every noon, random players will be infected with the plague, then the next noon, they will die, to stop them from death, you MUST INTERACT with a bed, not sleep in it, but just click on the bed and the plague will be removed! Just download the file, then put it into your servers plugin folder, restart your server and bam! (Also sometimes I do mass uploads, I make them in a long time and then upload them in 1 big group, and thanks for the support!)
